external_source.provenance: real minted receipt from the Metrecept production signing path (src/at_utility/receipts.py::mint_session_receipt) over a real served session read via GET /v1/sessions/{id}; gateway at iwasinnam2/ohm@53bc7f3; demo key — kid does not resolve against the live directory; decoded payload is the fixture level
external_source.stranger_verification_path: scripts/verify_receipt.py <jws> --base <gateway> against the gateway's public JWKS (RFC 7638 kid thumbprint); same kind-agnostic verifier as -002 — the signature covers the whole payload regardless of kind

scenario.description: One session (X-Ohm-Session: iwasinnam-003-demo), one byte-identical prompt sent three times: crossing 1 MISS (provider path, pipe_usd 0.001), crossings 2 and 3 served HITs (provider never called, pipe_usd 0.002 each). Each crossing carried its own per-request receipt in the X-Ohm-Receipt response header (-002 shape) with a distinct meter_event_id. The fixture receipt is the single aggregate cover minted at read time over those three already-ledgered crossings.
scenario.read: GET /v1/sessions/iwasinnam-003-demo (tenant-scoped, read-only over already-billed events; no new call is made)

wire_format.transport: inline `receipt` field of the GET /v1/sessions/{session_id} JSON body — aggregate kinds travel inline; per-request kinds travel detached in response headers, same JWS format either way

field_semantics.session_sha256: sha256 of the raw session id; the raw id never appears in the signed payload. Self-checkable: sha256('iwasinnam-003-demo') == session_sha256.
field_semantics.pipe_usd: sum of per-crossing pipe rent over the aggregate (0.001 + 0.002 + 0.002 = 0.005). The per-crossing receipts (meter_event_id) remain the money identities; this is a cover over them, not a collapse.
field_semantics.event_count / cache_hits / cache_misses: per-kind counts across every metered event tagged with this session id — chat completions and API-passthrough calls aggregate into the same cover.
field_semantics.first_ts / last_ts: earliest / latest metered-event timestamps inside the aggregate window.
field_semantics.iat: mint time at the GET — read-time, not write-time. Re-fetching the same session re-mints a fresh receipt with a new iat over the same underlying events.
field_semantics.no tenant_sha256: omitted by design: the receipt is fetched tenant-scoped (the tenant's own bearer key), unlike a header receipt which travels detached and so carries a truncated tenant fingerprint.
field_semantics.no model / tokens fields: per-request fields don't apply to an aggregate over potentially many requests of different models and kinds.

limits.rule: The receipt signs pipe rent, not provider cost. pipe_usd is what the pipe billed for the crossings and never claims to be the provider invoice amount. Provider-cost assertions must come from provider-side columns, never from this payload.

estimated_provider_avoided_usd is NOT a receipt field at aggregate grain either: it lives in the usage ledger, is hit-only by design, and is unsigned, estimate-only, always labelled as such. The signed aggregate carries only what was actually billed.

The aggregate cannot express per-crossing shape: which crossing was which model, and the provider prompt-cache discounted-crossing shape (provider called, cache_read on the invoice, discounted-but-nonzero — -002's L3), are invisible at this grain. Per-kind money splits and request-3 shapes must be modeled on the meter side from the per-crossing receipts, not recovered from this payload.

iat, first_ts and last_ts are claims, not proofs of time. The signature proves this key signed these bytes; the timestamps are more fields in them. When-proofs are handled separately (Merkle clock over signature hashes — every minted receipt, this kind included, is recorded as a leaf).

N crossings produce one signed cover; the per-crossing receipts remain the money identities. Repeat hits on the byte-identical request are distinct metered crossings, one per HTTP request — summed here, never merged.

session_sha256 is the only session identifier in the payload; the raw id is never embedded. Membership of a crossing in the session is established by the producer's ledger; the receipt asserts the aggregate over it, verifiable only against the digest.

observer_grade_mapping.signed_aggregate_fields: settlement-grade (signature proves key signed bytes; L1/L3/L5 bound the claim scope)
observer_grade_mapping.estimated_provider_avoided_usd: estimate-only, unsigned — not present in this payload at all (L2)
